strategy.thesis: Israel's largest and longest-running generalist VC platform (Pitango First / Growth / HealthTech) runs a dedicated HealthTech fund and team investing in biopharma, digital health and medical-technology companies alongside its broad-tech early-stage and growth funds.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: HealthTech fund/team is a distinct vertical within the generalist Pitango platform, separate from Pitango First and Pitango Growth.

summary.en: Pitango is Israel's largest generalist VC platform, with a dedicated Pitango HealthTech fund (two vintages, $150M + $175M) investing in biopharma, digital health and medtech alongside its early-stage and growth funds.

strategy.thesis: Global equity-crowdfunding/VC platform investing broadly across tech sectors that launched OurCrowd Qure, Israel's first dedicated digital-health fund, backing Israel-based digital health startups from seed through late-stage follow-ons.

summary.en: OurCrowd is a Jerusalem-based global equity-crowdfunding/VC platform that in 2016 launched OurCrowd Qure, Israel's first exclusive digital-health fund; the $50M vehicle has backed 12 companies including Tyto Care, DarioHealth (IPO) and Zebra Medical Vision (acquired).

strategy.thesis: Israel's leading generalist early-stage VC platform (part of Viola Group) invests 25-30 companies per fund across sectors and has an explicit consumer/digital-health thesis, backing companies such as Immunai and Lin Health.

strategy.thesis: Team8 is a generalist venture-creation group (cyber, fintech, data infrastructure, AI) that launched Team8 Health, a dedicated digital-health venture-creation fund co-building and seed-investing in 1-2 new startups per year at the intersection of cyber, AI, fintech and healthcare.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Team8 Health builds companies in-house with serial entrepreneurs (venture-creation / foundry model) rather than purely investing in existing startups.

summary.en: Team8 is a Tel Aviv-based generalist venture-creation group (AUM well over $1B across cyber/fintech/data/AI funds) that launched Team8 Health, a $70M venture-creation fund building 6-8 digital-health startups over five years.

strategy.thesis: Primarily a cybersecurity/enterprise-software generalist VC, but with verifiable health investments including Healthee (digital health insurance navigation) and Genoox (genomics/diagnostics platform, acquired by QIAGEN).
